$comment: A collaboration: Kronk is Tal's platform, and Cassidy has helped build it. Facts from projects/kronk-booth/README.md and the Kronk Booth session (checked against the repo and the live site, 9 Nov 2026); Cassidy to review. Sharing permission confirmed by Cassidy, 9 Nov 2026. The action is a guided tour with example data (demos/kronk/), because Kronk is invite-only: the tour ends at Kronk's public About page, never a sign-up. Kronk itself is a digital collaboration (Digital Creations only); its Booth has its own music entry, kronk-booth.json (Cassidy, 11 Nov 2026).
title: Kronk
description: A community-owned social platform run by Tal. Cassidy has helped build the Booth, Kronk's stage for music.
portfolioDescription: Kronk is a community-owned social platform at kronk.info, run by Tal. Every relationship is a mutual Mate, members choose how far each post reaches, and there is no algorithmic ranking. Changes to how it runs are proposed and decided openly on Kronk itself. It started as a fork of Mastodon and has been its own platform since 2.0 (September 2026).
body: The Booth is Kronk's stage for music, with DJ sets, mixes, tracks, albums, readings and live sets. It plays music made by members and credits who made it.
Wachuneed is Kronk's marketplace, where members offer and ask for art, stuff and services from each other. Kronk handles no payment: buyer and seller agree that between them.
role: Contributor. Cassidy built the Booth tidy (#2127, merged 13 Oct 2026); live sets and listening tools (#2339, merged 23 Oct 2026: My sets, saves, kinds, sort, play next, Remind me, Shoutouts, First listens and a live banner); and the FreeTheDream korner, the map inside Kronk (#1988 and #2010, merged Oct 2026). More Booth work is in progress.

images.alt: The Kronk tour's welcome, with example data: “A small community, built together”, beside a map of what you'll see: Home, Mates, the Hub, the Booth, Live, Wachuneed and Join.
The Kronk tour's Home step: a feed of made-up members' posts in time order.
The Kronk tour's Mates step: a post with its reach ladder (Just me, Mates, Orbit, Kronkverse) and made-up people you might know.
The Kronk tour's Hub: korners such as the Booth, Kalendar, Kommons, Kuestions, Moments, Wachuneed, Albutts and Krew, each to tune in to.
Kronk's About page: a ring of round icons for About, How-it-works, Contributors, Governance, Rules, Privacy and Terms around the Kronk emblem, on a dark background.
